title: 9 Best Craft Beer in Gyeongju
description: The best craft beer in Gyeongju — curated from Reddit reviews. Taprooms, breweries, and craft beer bars near the ancient tombs. Interactive map included.

places.name: Heuheuheu (흐흐흐)

redditQuotes.text: There is such a nice vibe about the place. With the big windows, giving a beautiful view onto the tumuli tombs, it is so pleasant to sit outside and just... enjoy. They have delicious, properly sour, sour beers.
redditQuotes.source: — Google review via Wanderlog · Heuheuheu reviews

redditQuotes.text: Great atmosphere — suspect this is as much to do with the manager as the venue itself — and the beers were good too. We tried one of the Korean IPAs available on draught. Highly recommend.

places.verdict: The undisputed #1 craft beer spot in Gyeongju.

comparison.best for: Craft Beer Taproom in Noseo-dong, near the tumuli with a ₩7,000–₩12,000/pint spend range
comparison.strengths: Craft Beer Taproom · Noseo-dong, near the tumuli
comparison.why it made the list: The undisputed #1 craft beer spot in Gyeongju. The 4.8-star rating across 140+ reviews isn't inflated — the combination of excellent beer, friendly English-speaking staff, and that view of ancient Silla tombs through the big windows is genuinely special. Opens at 4 PM and fills up fast on weekends.

places.name: Whasoo Brewery (화수브루어리)

redditQuotes.text: Whasoo Brewery in Gyeongju where you can pour your own pints! A stunning line up — pale ale, lager, porter, weizen, bock, stout, IPA.
redditQuotes.source: — Facebook · Breweries of the World group

redditQuotes.text: A good microbrewery in Gyeongju. Discovered this place during my visit to the city. Got an IPA that tasted great.

places.verdict: Gyeongju's only proper microbrewery — they make everything on-site and the quality is legit.

places.name: Hey Hey Hey (헤이헤이헤이)

redditQuotes.text: At night we found some great bars. Hey Hey Hey, a craft beer spot, stood out for its friendly atmosphere and excellent beer.
redditQuotes.source: — r/koreatravel · Trip report: Just back and sharing experience

redditQuotes.text: I love this pub! One of my favourite craft beer bars in Korea.

places.verdict: The go-to craft beer bar right in the heart of the Hwangnidangil action.

comparison.best for: Craft Beer Bar in Hwangnidangil area with a ₩7,000–₩12,000/pint spend range
comparison.why it made the list: The go-to craft beer bar right in the heart of the Hwangnidangil action. Reddit travelers consistently praise the friendly vibe and solid beer selection. It's the kind of place where you walk in for one pint and end up staying for three. Perfect post-sightseeing stop after a day exploring the tombs.

places.name: Bar Boon

redditQuotes.text: Tucked away in Hwangnam Market, this intimate bar exudes warmth, with music and an unmistakable sense of character. The owner refined his craft in San Diego before returning to Korea, and his drinks reflect both international experience and a strong local identity.

places.verdict: Not a beer bar per se, but Gyeongju's best cocktail spot deserves a place on any drinking guide.

comparison.best for: Cocktails & Korean Spirits in Hwangnam Market area with a ₩12,000–₩18,000/drink spend range
comparison.strengths: 5★ from 808 Google reviews · Cocktails & Korean Spirits · Hwangnam Market area
comparison.limitations: Gyeongju's best cocktail spot deserves a place on any drinking guide
comparison.why it made the list: Not a beer bar per se, but Gyeongju's best cocktail spot deserves a place on any drinking guide. Jay Choi brings San Diego cocktail culture to the Silla capital. The Korean-inspired menu using local spirits and ingredients makes this genuinely unique — you won't find these drinks anywhere else. Perfect for the craft beer crowd who also appreciates good cocktails.

places.name: Bar Prep

redditQuotes.text: Bar Prep's charm lies in its simplicity: it focuses on classic cocktails done properly, with an emphasis on balance and precision. The bartenders here are skilled, but there's no sense of pretension — just great drinks served with quiet confidence.

places.verdict: Scandinavian-minimalist design meets Korean craft cocktails.

comparison.best for: Cocktails & Local Spirits in Downtown Gyeongju with a ₩12,000–₩20,000/drink spend range
comparison.strengths: 4.9★ from 144 Google reviews · Cocktails & Local Spirits · Downtown Gyeongju
comparison.why it made the list: Scandinavian-minimalist design meets Korean craft cocktails. The star here is Temonje 1779 — a rice-based spirit with a legacy dating back to 1779, crafted exclusively in Gyeongju. If you appreciate the "craft" in craft beverages, this is where Gyeongju's artisanal drinking scene shines brightest. Opens at 4 PM, making it an ideal first stop before dinner.

places.name: Gyodong Beopju Brewery (교동법주)

redditQuotes.text: Visitors to the brewery can also enjoy a quiet stroll through the historic home of the Gyeongju Choi clan.
redditQuotes.source: — Chosun Ilbo · Brewery and Lotus Leaves Among Cocktail of Delights

places.verdict: A detour from craft beer, but an essential Gyeongju experience.

comparison.best for: Traditional Korean Brewery in Gyo-dong, Gyeongju with a ₩5,000–₩15,000 spend range
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 31 Google reviews · Traditional Korean Brewery · Gyo-dong, Gyeongju
comparison.why it made the list: A detour from craft beer, but an essential Gyeongju experience. This brewery has been making traditional rice wine using a centuries-old recipe in the same neighborhood where the Silla aristocracy lived. It's a UNESCO-adjacent cultural experience that happens to involve alcohol — the best kind. Combine it with a walk through the Gyochon Traditional Village.

redditQuotes.text: Gyeongju Craft Beer produces their Kim YuSin Pale Ale and other locally inspired brews — a small operation but genuine craft brewing.

places.verdict: A smaller local operation compared to Whasoo, but the Kim YuSin Pale Ale — named after the Silla dynasty's greatest general — is worth seeking out.

places.name: Hwangnidangil Beer Street (황리단길)

redditQuotes.text: Just head to Hwangnidangil area. Tonnns of spots there on the main drag and in the alleys behind it. Just remember that Gyeongju is more small town vibes.
It's become the 'hippest' spot in Gyeongju for the last 10 years. Full of trendy cafes, restaurants, and souvenir shops in renovated hanoks, all mixed in with tomb views.
redditQuotes.source: — r/koreatravel (Gyeongju native) · Your guide to the real Gyeongju

places.verdict: Not a single bar, but Gyeongju's entire drinking district — and honestly, half the fun is the bar crawl itself.
